own_solution.law: The allowed Zeeman shifts are mu_B B(g_u m_u-g_l m_l). Their extreme separation is (g_u+g_l)mu_B B, giving delta_lambda=lambda_0^2(g_u+g_l)mu_B B/(hc). The supplied constants give mu_B=5.7887803e-5 eV/T.
assumptions: Use the stated linear weak-field Zeeman model and first-order wavelength conversion.
All six allowed electronic electric-dipole components are observed.
The additional field at the vapour increases its field magnitude by the stated amount.
Convert energies consistently between joules and electronvolts.
